title: 10.4 Inscribed Angles and Polygons

icans: I can find the measure of an inscribed angle or its intercepted arc.
I can use the fact that a triangle inscribed in a semicircle is a right triangle.
I can use the fact that opposite angles of an inscribed quadrilateral are supplementary.

vocab: an angle whose vertex is on a circle and whose sides __________ chords of the circle
the arc that lies in the interior of an ____________ angle and has endpoints on the angle
a polygon whose ___________ all lie on a circle
the circle that contains all the vertices of an ____________ polygon
